subject: website
name: Gnosis VPN documentation
summary: The Gnosis VPN documentation. Its source is public (no licence file) and it runs no third-party code of its own, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it loads an icon font from jsDelivr, and its search sends each query to Algolia, a centralized service.

operations.name: Read the documentation pages
operations.note: Static pages served from the build's own files.

operations.name: Search the documentation
operations.note: The bundled DocSearch code sends the typed query to Algolia and shows what it returns; nothing checks the results.

connections.name: Tabler icon font (cdn.jsdelivr.net)
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens, with no integrity hash.

connections.name: Algolia search (p6p7itp8ln-dsn.algolia.net)
connections.note: Only preconnected at load; queries go there when the visitor searches. Centralized, and it sees the visitor's IP address and queries.
